data.name: Balbir
data.long_meaning: Balbir is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bal' (brave) and 'Bir' (lion). The name signifies being courageous like a lion. In Hindu mythology, Balbir is a name of Lord Hanuman, who is revered for his bravery and unwavering devotion.
